title: Cumbia
tagline: A Colombian-rooted dance rhythm that keeps changing across the Americas.
summary: Cumbia originated on Colombia's Caribbean coast through the meeting of Indigenous, African, and European musical traditions. Its dance rhythm and instrumentation traveled widely, inspiring distinct regional versions across Latin America. Modern cumbia continues to absorb local sounds, from orchestral and tropical arrangements to electronic production.

pillars.name: Andrés Landero
pillars.why: Landero helped popularize accordion-led cumbia and is widely associated with the genre's Colombian tradition.

pillars.name: Lucho Bermúdez
pillars.why: Bermúdez arranged Colombian Caribbean music for large orchestras and helped bring cumbia to wider audiences.

pillars.name: Los Corraleros de Majagual
pillars.why: The group brought together prominent coastal musicians in a celebrated, influential tropical-cumbia ensemble.
